thesis: ASO has run +66% in 63 days with no company-specific catalyst, and the news card attributes the 52-week high to a sector and sentiment move on holiday-retail enthusiasm. Price sits above the mean analyst target, revenue growth is cooling, and Q3 earnings on 2026-12-08 fall inside the swing window after a parabolic run, so the gap risk is asymmetric to the downside. The regime is risk-off with VIX at the 99th percentile, and high-beta momentum names tend to be sold hard when correlations spike. The breakout has no volume confirmation, and 19.5% short interest makes both directions violent, which hurts a stop at 66.7 because a gap can skip it.
